newsitem.title: USA: Voyager buys three mutual funds.
newsitem.headline: Voyager buys three mutual funds.

text.p: Voyager Cos' Voyager Investments said it bought three mutual funds.
It bought from Fortis Investments Inc the Fortis New York Tax Free Portfolio Fund, which will become the Voyager New York Tax Free Fund on Sept 19.
Voyager bought the Great Hall National Tax Exempt Fund and Great Hall Minnesota Insured Tax Exempt Fund from Interregional Financial Group earlier this month.
The National tax exempt fund will be called the Voyager National High Yield Municipal Fund, and the Minnesotat fund will be absorbed by the Voyager Minnesota Insured Fund.
Voyager said the deals have been approved by all boards and must be approved by shareholders.
Voyager operates 31 tax-free funds, four equity funds, and one government securities fund, and has a total of $11.9 million in assets under management.
